description: A forceful STAFF STRIKE towards the RIGHT. Anticipation: lift the staff arm overhead and lean back. Impact: swing the long staff down and forward in a wide clear arc until it points horizontally to the right, with an extended arm and bent leading knee. Recovery: draw it back upright into idle. The OTHER hand holds the balance scale unchanged. Large readable arm and staff motion; no spellcasting. STRICT side-scroller view facing RIGHT for every frame, never turn toward camera. Clear anticipation, strong action and recovery. Preserve identity and crisp bone-silver charcoal pixel art, no new colors. Keep full sprite and moving weapons inside 256x192, same planted baseline, same scale. Static camera. Transparent. Stay in place; no camera pan.
